name: Footer navigation links open the corresponding pages
description:
Visitors can use the footer to navigate the website,
  view contact information and open Victory Center social media profiles.
descriptionHtml:
Visitors can use the footer to navigate the website,
view contact information and open Victory Center social media profiles.

testStage.description:
Visitors can use the footer to navigate the website,
  view contact information and open Victory Center social media profiles.

steps.name: Given the Victory Center home page is open
When the visitor scrolls to the footer
And the visitor clicks the footer navigation link for "/about-us"
Then the page at "/about-us" opens on the Victory Center website
And the page displays non-empty content
Wait for non-empty public page content
And the page does not display a 404 or page-not-found message
Wait for non-empty public page content
